question: What is the provenance of the one exact full-answer UTF-8 hit reported in physical RAM after the Edge tab closed?

method.known_value_source: Actual synthetic pre-close page screenshot and privately retained page observation; used only after the blind close-tab result was sealed
method.probe_field_source: The observe mode of probe_chrome_cdp.ps1 constructs an object with url, user, assistant, textTail and dataConversation from the live page.

later_exact_offset_process_map.method: The hash-verified gzip was read through the indexed Volatility 3 reader; the physmatches plugin checked this one exact physical offset against user-space mappings from all image-derived pslist entries.

interpretation: The sole exact full-answer physical hit sits inside the page-observation probe's serialized textTail field. It had no user-space mapping among the 130 enumerated entries with readable user rows at acquisition. It is an investigator-created copy, not independent evidence that Edge retained the answer after tab closure. The negative bounded-record results stand. This does not rule out partial answer text, a different encoding or representation, or physically scattered application objects elsewhere in the image.
